item.title: Kamalvandi: Protecting information on Iran’s nuclear sites is highly important
item.description: London, IRNA – Spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI) Behrouz Kamalvandi has stressed the importance of protecting information about Iranian nuclear facilities, including damaged sites, citing the possibility of further attacks and the International Atomic Energy Agency’s (IAEA) failure to safeguard such information.

item.title: War proved US cannot be legitimate superpower: Army
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akrami-Nia says the US-Israeli war on Iran demonstrated that the United States cannot appear as a legitimate superpower, arguing that the world is moving toward a “post-American” order.

item.title: Army Ground Force chief hails Iran’s strategic weapons capabilities
item.description: Mashhad, IRNA – Chief Commander of the Iranian Army Ground Force Brigadier General Ali Jahanshahi says Iran’s Armed Forces are currently more prepared in terms of capabilities, combat readiness, and operational reserves than they were before the US-Israeli war on the country, highlighting their capabilities in strategic weapons, particularly missiles and drones.

item.title: All vessels in Persian Gulf region under Iran’s watch: IRGC Navy
item.description: Sari, IRNA – No vessel can move through the Persian Gulf, the Strait of Hormuz, or the Sea of Oman without being monitored by Iran, a senior official of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy says, stressing that the force has the capability to strike any vessel if ordered.

item.title: In photos: Sugarcane plantations covering farms in southwest Iran
item.description: Sugarcane plantations cover about 16,500 hectares of farmland in Khuzestan Province. Planting began in mid‑August and continues until late September, and due to the province’s intense heat, the work is done in the early hours of the day.

item.title: Iran should use shifting global order to mitigate sanctions impact: MP
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – A member of the Iranian Parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Commission has called for leveraging emerging opportunities in the changing global order, saying expanded cooperation with independent countries can help Iran mitigate the impact of sanctions.
